title: Winning captains 2017 to 2026
brief: Name the captain of the Champions League winners in each final from 2017 to 2026: the player who wore the armband at kick-off.
sources: Transfermarkt final match reports (captain's armband on the line-up), ids in cl_finals_1993_2026.csv
checks: Built from cl_finals_1993_2026.csv (winner_captain), which CL-B read from each final's Wikipedia team sheet and Transfermarkt match report; the two agree for every final. The 4-slot rule applies to the answers (the captains): Ramos and Marquinhos fill two slots each.
